capabilities: Display daily notes in a sidebar calendar with mood emojis beneath each date
Create daily notes via a mood picker that writes the mood to frontmatter
Embed the calendar in notes with a mood-calendar code block
Edit a note's mood property through a hover picker
Show per-date status dots for missing notes and unfinished tasks
disambiguation: Not a general calendar plugin; it is a mood-tracking view built specifically around daily notes.
extras: Works on mobile (isDesktopOnly: false); bilingual UI (English/Chinese); written in plain JavaScript with no build step; README includes a star request but no screenshots in the stripped text.
intentEvidence: Automatically reads the date format, folder, and template from the built-in Daily Notes or Periodic Notes plugin
problem: Obsidian's daily notes workflow has no calendar view that visualizes each day's mood or lets you log a mood while creating the note.
